title: Unit and cocycle laws for derived inverse restriction
statement: The canonical derived inverse-restriction unit and compositors satisfy both identity equations and the three-ring-isomorphism cocycle, including the natural eqToIso of ring-isomorphism reassociation. These are equalities on every object of the ordinary unbounded derived category. Dependencies: [lem-pur-u2-restriction-comparisons].

source.place: Tags 04VG/04VK and 015F; exact derived-functor unit and compositor coherence

proof.text: For identity comparisons, the ordinary natural isomorphism is the identity on sections. The exact derived image of an identity natural isomorphism is identity, so the derived comparison reduces to the exact-derived unit/compositor.

from.place: Proof steps for normalized coefficient transport

lean.statement:
theorem derived_assoc {R S T V : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{r}}
    (a : R ≅ S) (b : S ≅ T) (c : T ≅ V)
    (X : DerivedCategory (scalarModules J R)) :
    (scalarRestriction c.inv).mapDerivedCategory.map ((derivedComp a b).hom.app X) ≫
      (derivedComp (a ≪≫ b) c).hom.app X ≫
      (eqToIso (congrArg (fun d : R ≅ V ↦
        (scalarRestriction d.inv).mapDerivedCategory) (Iso.trans_assoc a b c))).hom.app X =
    (derivedComp b c).hom.app ((scalarRestriction a.inv).mapDerivedCategory.obj X) ≫
      (derivedComp a (b ≪≫ c)).hom.app X
